path.id: Step into a monumental crystal cathedral of light. Our signature Glass House is a breathtaking clear-span marquee structure that merges the organic beauty of surrounding nature with flawless, luxury indoor comforts. Designed and engineered for safety and grandeur, it forms the perfect architectural stage for Indiaâ€™s finest celebrations.

Cross the threshold of transition under an ethereal crescent archway. The MoonGate represents unity, eternity, and natural perfection. Our structural design integrates precise halo LED lighting within a circular portal, flanked by lush custom botanicals and elegant floating walkways over tranquil water elements.

Our production capabilities are virtually limitless. Collaborate directly with our in-house engineering and visual design teams to draft, structure, light, and deliver a completely bespoke stage set tailored to your exact physical parameters.
Send us a message about your upcoming event location, desired date, and set visions. Our premium coordinators will get back to you with custom proposals.
Crafting extraordinary events since 2006. Premium lighting, power, and production.

Experience turnkey architectural masterpieces crafted specifically for luxurious destination weddings, monumental galas, and breathtaking experiences.

Step into a monumental crystal cathedral of light. Our signature Glass House is a breathtaking clear-span marquee structure that merges the organic beauty of surrounding nature with flawless, luxury indoor comforts. Designed and engineered for safety and grandeur.

Cross the threshold under an ethereal crescent archway. The MoonGate represents unity, eternity, and natural perfection. Features precise halo LED lighting within a circular portal, flanked by custom botanicals and elegant floating walkways.
